title: Asset+
wikitext:
Some assets will have a '+' in their name to designate that they are a special variant of their normal type. These assets are optionally used by facilities to increase their chances of producing their own '+' variant outputs. Assets that are '+' also have a 4x multiplier on their value when selling in retail stores. Using $$scp (facility), you can increase your asset+ produce chance by double your current asset+ chance.
Asset+ also [[scrap]] for twice as much scrap as a regular asset.
html:
Some assets will have a '+' in their name to designate that they are a special variant of their normal type. These assets are optionally used by facilities to increase their chances of producing their own '+' variant outputs. Assets that are '+' also have a 4x multiplier on their value when selling in retail stores.

Using $$scp (facility), you can increase your asset+ produce chance by double your current asset+ chance.
Asset+ also scrap for twice as much scrap as a regular asset.
